name: Bloody Hopes critical catalog
notice: critic_ready confirms complete published lyrics and page context. Historical bibliographies are not yet curated for every song.

songs.title: That Austerlitz Sun
songs.description: Beneath Austerlitz’s brilliant sky, a dying soldier imagines the glorious return, medals, and family reunion that will never come.

songs.title: Blood for Blood, Scar for Scar
songs.description: A Dutch colonial column burns through Suriname’s rainforest, where fever, vanished villages, and returning hammocks turn conquest into stain.

songs.title: Broken Mirrors
songs.description: A fictional war widow shares the fragments of a mirror that once held a promise, turning private grief into shared memory without pretending that loss can be repaired.

songs.title: Cheers to Fritz, and to Hell with Fritz
songs.description: An old Prussian soldier drinks to fallen comrades while both toasting and damning Frederick the Great, the king who made legends and ghosts.

songs.title: There Will Be Mourning in Farmington
songs.description: A fifteen-minute fight near Atlanta reaches Farmington as a casualty list, carrying war house by house, name by name, into waiting homes.

songs.title: He Raised His Hands
songs.description: At Gettysburg, a glory-hungry recruit bayonets a surrendering boy, receives a medal, and discovers that public honor cannot silence moral injury.

songs.title: Four Days, Four Nights
songs.description: During the Morristown winter, four days without bread drive Continental soldiers to chew bark and march beside hunger like another enemy.

songs.title: Italy Will Be Made!
songs.description: A dispossessed Italian officer serves Napoleon from Marengo to Russia, carrying a faded tricolour and one dying promise: Italy will be made.

songs.title: The Lancaster's Brigade Ribbon
songs.description: A dying nineteen-year-old asks his platoon to carry a ribbon, a wedding promise, and a merciful lie home to his mother and bride.

songs.title: For a Better World
songs.description: A scarred pocket watch leads a descendant from Baltimore to Leipzig, uncovering two teenage soldiers and the promise they left behind.

songs.title: Into the Guns
songs.description: A mistaken order sends the Light Brigade into Balaclava’s guns, where young riders dream of glory and veterans ride knowing the grave.

songs.title: Blessed Is the Man Who Smiles
songs.description: At Montréal’s 1760 surrender, a smile passes between soldiers and civilians as a small act of courage beyond flags, rank, and victory.

songs.title: Not a Drop of Water
songs.description: A deadpan USS Constitution ballad records untouched water, vanished rum and wine, and a crew whose naval prudence borders on mutiny.

songs.title: Rum, Alabama, Rum!
songs.description: A comic CSS Alabama forebitter follows Semmes’s raider around the world as captured spirits vanish and the crew heroically avoids water.

songs.title: Send the Italian
songs.description: Pigafetta, John Martin, and Giuseppe Biagi survive three disasters as the Italians sent to carry the record, the order, or the signal.

songs.title: Surrender, Swim, or Fight
songs.description: At Shiloh, soldiers trapped between fire and the Tennessee River face three impossible choices, and survival becomes the wound they carry home.

songs.title: The Elephant
songs.description: A sixteen-year-old chases the Civil War’s “elephant” of combat and returns knowing that glory is the story honest survivors refuse to repeat.

songs.title: What Mercy Had To Do
songs.description: A wounded Confederate is saved by the Union sergeant who captures him, and mercy turns two enemies into the family war took from them.

songs.title: The Smile Inside the Square
songs.description: A British infantryman kills a smiling French cavalryman at Waterloo and learns that the glory each sought leaves only one survivor haunted.
